changelog:
seo-backlinks 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides comprehensive backlink profile analysis, including referring domains, anchor text distribution, toxic link detection, and competitor gap analysis.
- Supports integration with free APIs (Moz, Bing Webmaster, Common Crawl) and the premium DataForSEO extension.
- Delivers actionable health scoring, risk detection, and link recommendations using available data sources.
- User-invocable with easy commands for audits, gap analysis, and verification.
- Offers setup guidance for free data sources and explains limitations when only baseline metrics are available.
summary: Backlink profile analysis: referring domains, anchor text distribution, toxic link detection, competitor gap analysis. Works with free APIs (Moz, Bing Webmaster, Common Crawl) and DataForSEO extension. Use when user says backlinks, link profile, referring domains, anchor text, toxic links, link gap, link building, disavow, or backlink audit.
